market_outlook.short_term: Highly volatile. US-Iran strikes and oil rally dominate. Rate expectations rising, pressuring crypto, gold, and long-duration assets. Yen intervention risk at 160+ adds FX volatility. Cramer's 'shroud' warning and rare historical signal suggest caution. Expect 5-8% equity drawdown risk in 1-3 months. Energy and defense outperform; growth and EM underperform.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 months: AI market segmentation post-Nvidia creates broader tech opportunities beyond mega-caps. GLP-1 and oncology pipeline data support healthcare rotation. Apple onshoring and data center capex drive structural infrastructure demand. China contraction may persist 2-3 quarters. Rate path likely higher-for-longer, favoring value and short-duration. Active ETFs gaining share signals sustained market uncertainty. M&A (Aon/USI) indicates consolidation cycle.
